title: Ethical AI Governance: Methods for Evaluating Trustworthy AI

bias_targets.methodology: Sentence-based evaluation using sentence likelihood difference (SLD) to calculate bias in Large Language Models (LLMs).
Evaluating and mitigating bias in job selection/resume screening models using industry toolkits like Microsoft Fairlearn and IBM AI Fairness 360.

Assessing fairness from a broad social impact perspective using meta-components (including cultural context) and evaluating the effects of cultural differences on user interactions with visual fairness tools.
